restrictions: Fixed-IV SHA-256, first 40 steps, standard padding and feed-forward, equality of all 256 output bits; one 64-byte data block per message from the standard IV, followed by the common SHA-256 padding block (equal inputs give the equal padding block, so a first-data-block collision is a full-message collision).

Prices: one 40-step target compression is one unit; every other primitive word operation is 1/C with C = 2896. Verifying a found pair is 4 reduced compressions (the data block and the padding block of each of the two messages), charged as one unit each (4 units per found pair), separately from the word operations.

Head (proof Section 2): the shipped v7/v7e program (bit-sliced on 256 lanes; a gate on 256 lanes counts as one word operation, as in our own round-40 entry df1f1cd1, in review; per-lane accounting adds exactly 8 bits), 3,935.5 charged operations per kept pair = (983.865 word operations = 201.865 generation + 782 junction recognition) x 4 for their loads and stores; generation = the per-batch budget 38,758 (the maximum of 20,000 measured batches; the program halts before passing its budget) divided by the kept-lane floor 192 of 256 (premise H-kept-pair-yield) (the program's own control loop rebuilds each kept lane's schedule and runs steps 23..26 of both members to confirm the landing; charged here by exact count, 2^0.44247 units), hard operation cap, pair-output path with 4 reduced verification compressions; full 40-word schedule control on every kept pair.

Landing and tail (proof Section 3): the J26 difference lands on the target with probability 2^-256 per pair (premise P1, a declared heuristic: the exact full-width rate is the premise, measured jointly to 32 bits and consistent, not a measured fact); from the target the pair collides after step 40 with probability 1 (premise P2, by construction: the schedule difference is silent on the words after the junction and the target cancels the step-26 word difference, so the two computations coincide from the junction on; 5000/5000 forced-target implementation check, negative control 0/2000).
Ledger: N = ln(1/0.61) x 2^256 pairs; T = N x 2^0.44247 + 4 x (found pairs), N kept pairs produced from at most N/192 batches; log2 T = 255.42592 (exact 255.42591814, rounded up).

Memory by construction (complete under the model): list subsets 357,408 + program code 44,909 + 256-lane working state 73,728 + current messages 128 = 476,173 bytes (2^18.87; term max(0, log2-20) = 0). Preprocessing: 2^28.21 compressions in total (2^28.2 list construction + 422 subset selection, exponent rounded up) + 422 compressions of subset selection; the per-pair random word draws are charged as word operations.
Premises P1, P2, P3 (independence across pairs) are declared heuristics of the exploratory lane (proof Section 6).

heuristics.statement: For pairs output by the shipped program, the 256-bit J26 XOR difference equals the J26 target with probability 2^-256 per pair.
heuristics.scope: the shipped program's pairs, standard IV, 40 steps
heuristics.extrapolation: Measured k-bit landing on 2^36 head-induced states: 2^-8.00, 2^-16.00, 2^-23.98, 2^-31.83 for k = 8, 16, 24, 32; per-bit |p-0.5| <= 0.00001; extended to 256 bits under independence of bits. The shipped program over 20,000 organizer-format trials (4,331,098 pairs): k=8 landing 16,883 (expected 16,918.4), k=16 landing 82 (expected 66.1); per-trial k=8 dispersion chi-square 20,067 vs 19,999 +- 200. Organizer-run evidence: every trial of experiment v40-headtail-01 reports landing_k8, landing_k16, landing_k24, landing_k32 and best_lead_bits for its kept pairs; the expected counts are kept x 2^-k, and the per-trial landing_k8 counts give the dispersion test for P3.
heuristics.limitations: Joint landing measured to 32 bits; the step to all 256 bits is the declared premise itself, not a derived bound. The v5 word-level generator is a cross-check only; the shipped program is v7/v7e.

heuristics.statement: A pair from the shipped program whose J26 difference equals the target collides after step 40 with probability 1.
heuristics.scope: the shipped program's pairs at the J26 target
heuristics.extrapolation: By construction: the schedule difference is silent on the words after the junction and the J26 target cancels the step-26 word difference, so from the junction on the two computations coincide and the pair collides. Implementation check: 5000/5000 with the target forced on real program states; negative control 0/2000.
heuristics.limitations: The implementation check uses forced-target states; the probability-1 claim rests on the structural argument.

heuristics.statement: Landing events of distinct pairs are independent.
heuristics.scope: pairs within and across shared batches
heuristics.extrapolation: k=4 landing correlation within batches -0.0009, across -0.0010, noise 0.0022 (8,192 pairs; 64-batch table in evidence). v7c (batch shares steps 0..12): chi-square independence test 259.3 vs 256 +- 22.6 (control 252.4), research junc7c.py. Over-dispersion test (research junc7c.py --k8): 64 batches x 512 pairs, per-batch k=8 J26 landing counts mean 2.094 (expected 2.000), variance 2.055 (Poisson 2.000), dispersion chi-square 65.0 on 64 batches (expected 64 +- 11.3): landings are Poisson across batches, no within-batch clustering. v7e (W13 = r + k x 6A09E667 per lane): GPU dispersion test vp7gpu.cu on 2^24-2^25 pairs per run, k=8 dispersion -0.52 sigma; all modes and seeds within +-2.2 sigma (research). Organizer-run evidence: the per-trial landing_k8 counts in the trusted report (each trial = one batch of 256 lanes) are the dispersion sample; under P3 their variance equals their mean.
heuristics.limitations: Tested on the landing indicators the program reports (to 32 bits); independence of the exact 256-bit event over the full run is the declared premise.

heuristics.statement: Every batch of 256 lanes of the shipped program keeps at least 192 lanes; the generation cost of a batch is at most 38,758 word operations.
heuristics.scope: the shipped program, standard IV, 40 steps, every batch of the run
heuristics.extrapolation: Measured over 20,000 organizer-format batches (4,331,098 kept pairs): kept per batch mean 216.5 (0.846), minimum 193; generation operations per batch minimum 38,064, maximum 38,758. Under per-lane keeping at rate 0.846 the binomial probability of a batch below 192 is about 2.5e-5; such a batch is discarded and its cost charged, an expected overhead factor below 1.00003, absorbed by the upward rounding of log2 T. The organizer report lists kept and ops_used for every trial.
heuristics.limitations: The floor and the per-batch maximum are measured bounds over 20,000 batches, declared as the charges, not proved for every seed.
